environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the SQS consumer with IAM role granting sqs:SendMessage to the same queue (for DLQ redrive). The SQS queue has no message attribute filtering or content validation. The RDS PostgreSQL instance accepts connections from the task's security group with a db user that has INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/SELECT privileges on all tables. No input validation middleware or SQL firewall is deployed. The HSM is used solely for payment_ref decryption and does not gate or validate message content.

config.queue: SQS Standard queue, no content-based filtering
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14, db user has full DML on schema
config.network: Task SG -> RDS SG port 5432 allowed
config.iam: Task role has sqs:ReceiveMessage, sqs:DeleteMessage, sqs:SendMessage
config.hsm: CloudHSM cluster for payment_ref decryption only
